name: Chandra Nalaar
description: A free-spirited, impulsive and incredibly powerful fire-conjuring planeswalker still growing into the hero she is destined to become.

timeline.summary: Gideon, regretting how things ended with Chandra, follows her toward Zendikar, guessing she is chasing the Eye of Ugin from a stolen scroll's map.
timeline.quote: After a short time, he regretted the way things had ended and decided to find her.

timeline.summary: Gideon's tracking of Chandra dead-ends at a barren pass in Akoum.
timeline.quote: Chandra's trail dead-ended at a barren mountain pass in Akoum

timeline.summary: The Magic Origins storyline is announced: five Planeswalkers' emotional awakenings, which ignited their sparks, across ten planes.
timeline.quote: Each of these characters experienced an emotional awakening powerful enough to ignite their spark and change their lives forever.

timeline.summary: The five origin stories are scheduled in order: Chandra, Liliana, Jace, Gideon, Nissa.
timeline.quote: Over the next five weeks, you'll be able to read all five origin stories in this column.

timeline.summary: Chandra and the fire monks chant and dance in a lava field, but Serenok scolds her for not joining the spell properly.
timeline.quote: "The spell will fail if you don't participate."

timeline.summary: A hellion bursts from the lava field and attacks the monks.
timeline.quote: Something gigantic burst forth from the lava bed.

timeline.summary: Chandra climbs the hellion, tricks it into biting its own armor, and has the monks unleash their fire at her, weaving it into a spike that drives the hellion off.
timeline.quote: she wove the strands of fire together into a needle-sharp streak of blindingly hot fire.

timeline.summary: Serenok tells Chandra she is ready and that she is Jaya.
timeline.quote: You're ready. You're her .

timeline.summary: Mother Luti wakes Chandra to tell her Serenok is dead.
timeline.quote: "Chandra. Serenok is dead."

timeline.summary: Serenok's memorial is held outside Keral Keep and Chandra, grieving, walks into the mountains.
timeline.quote: She walked away from the Keep, deeper into the mountains.

timeline.summary: Luti presents Serenok's mantle and reveals the monks have chosen Chandra as the new abbot.
timeline.quote: "I'm here to tell you we've already chosen one."

timeline.summary: Chandra initially refuses to be abbot, then wavers when Luti repeats Serenok's phrase about the perfect challenge.
timeline.quote: Then, as Serenok was fond of saying, this will be the perfect challenge for you,

timeline.summary: Gideon and Jace burst into the chamber as Chandra considers accepting the mantle.
timeline.quote: "It's good to see you, Chandra," said Gideon Jura. "We need your help."

timeline.summary: Gideon and Jace ask Chandra to join them against the Eldrazi, and Jace reminds her of her responsibility for Zendikar's state.
timeline.quote: You have a hand in Zendikar's current state.

timeline.summary: Chandra tells them to go, saying she belongs on Regatha and has made a promise.
timeline.quote: "I belong here. I've made a promise."

timeline.summary: Gideon and Jace planeswalk away, and Chandra walks up the steps toward Mother Luti and the mantle.
timeline.quote: Chandra nodded to Mother Luti, and walked up the steps toward her.

timeline.summary: Chandra, abbot of Keral Keep, cannot write her Mount Keralia Address and struggles to keep her promise to stay on Regatha.
timeline.quote: She had made a promise.

timeline.summary: Chandra planeswalks to Zendikar for just one peek and lands near Sea Gate.
timeline.quote: She pressed her will against the whereness around her, forcing it to change.

timeline.summary: Chandra watches Gideon direct the placement of a hedron into the ring over the water.
timeline.quote: One of the larger hedrons, hovering over the water, was moving .

timeline.summary: A scout on a manta nearly spots Chandra, who runs into three Eldrazi.
timeline.quote: she was face-to-faceplate with a trio of angular, meaty-ribbed, bony-headed creatures.

timeline.summary: Chandra kills the three Eldrazi with fire.
timeline.quote: creating a tripartite blade of fire that sliced through each one of them.

timeline.summary: As she leaves, Chandra sees Ulamog advancing on Sea Gate and realizes this is what she helped unleash.
timeline.quote: This was what she had helped unleash.

timeline.summary: Back on Regatha, Mother Luti summons Chandra to the Address, and Chandra burns her speech.
timeline.quote: The pages burst into flames, burning up in a flash.

timeline.summary: Chandra gives a clumsy address, then tells the monks to trust themselves and find their own purposes.
timeline.quote: trust yourself. Trust your gift.

timeline.summary: Chandra announces she is leaving for Zendikar and Mother Luti forbids it, invoking her promise.
timeline.quote: I forbid you to leave.

timeline.summary: Mother Luti reveals it was a test, blesses Chandra's departure and takes back the abbot's robe.
timeline.quote: Go and save worlds.

timeline.summary: Chandra arrives at Sea Gate and finds Ulamog trapped in the hedron ring while Zendikari cheer.
timeline.quote: Ulamog was trapped.

timeline.summary: A winged demon draws power from the hedron prison, causing the hedrons to fall and freeing Ulamog.
timeline.quote: The circle was breaking.

timeline.summary: Chandra fails to hurt the demon or the titan, and a second Eldrazi titan rises from the ground.
timeline.quote: A second Eldrazi titan had entered the battle.

timeline.summary: Nicol Bolas arranges for Sarkhan Vol, Jace and Chandra to converge on the Eye and unknowingly reactivate it.
timeline.quote: the elder dragon Planeswalker Nicol Bolas arranged for three Planeswalkers to converge on the Eye and unknowingly reactivate it.

timeline.summary: Gideon recruits Jace on Ravnica but not Liliana or Chandra, and the two return to Zendikar.
timeline.quote: Together, Gideon and Jace returned to Zendikar to face the threat of the Eldrazi.

timeline.summary: Chandra leaves Keral Keep for Zendikar and finds Ob Nixilis disrupting the hedron network.
timeline.quote: she left the Keep for Zendikar...only to find Ob Nixilis disrupting the hedron network.

timeline.summary: Vision of the future: Tazri serves Kozilek and watches him kill Gideon, the other planeswalkers lying dead.
timeline.quote: Gideon Jura burst, and a bloody bag of ruptured flesh and broken bones fell limply to the ash-white earth below

timeline.summary: Chandra searches the battlefield for Gideon and Jace while two titans wander the land and a swarm approaches.
timeline.quote: Too many to take on by herself.

timeline.summary: Chandra finds Gideon's dented buckler in the mud and recalls her parents' deaths on Kaladesh.
timeline.quote: It was a large buckler shield, wedged in a depression of mud.

timeline.summary: Tazri and wounded scouts hail Chandra from a ravine and tell her the demon took Gideon and two others to a cavern.
timeline.quote: The demon took him, and two others.

timeline.summary: Chandra lures the Eldrazi swarm away from Tazri's wounded in a cyclone of fire.
timeline.quote: A roaring cyclone made of churning flame whirled across the field ahead of her

timeline.summary: Chandra reaches the cavern, sees visions of her parents in the crust, and smashes the barrier.
timeline.quote: The crust exploded.

timeline.summary: Chandra finds Gideon, Jace and Nissa suspended in midair by enervating magic and challenges the demon.
timeline.quote: I'm inviting myself,

timeline.summary: The demon overpowers Chandra, drains her fire and mimics her parents' voices to make her give up.
timeline.quote: You've failed them, Chandra. Just like you failed us .

timeline.summary: Jace tells Chandra by telepathy to burn the Eldrazi drones, and she rallies and does so, freeing her friends.
timeline.quote: slamming into the Eldrazi drones that lurked near her friends.

timeline.summary: The captives vanish into invisibility and reappear as the demon seizes Gideon by the neck.
timeline.quote: The demon already had him by the neck, raising him up off his feet.

timeline.summary: Chandra, Gideon, Jace and Nissa attack the demon together and defeat him.
timeline.quote: All four of them attacked the demon simultaneously.

timeline.summary: Chandra's fire cyclone blasts the demon, who promises revenge across the planes and vanishes.
timeline.quote: The air folded in on itself, swallowing the demon, and he was gone.

timeline.summary: Chandra and the others reunite as Nissa introduces herself, and the Eldrazi swarm Chandra lured arrives.
timeline.quote: The Eldrazi swarm, the same horde that Chandra had lured away from Sea Gate, came skittering into the chamber

timeline.summary: Gideon leads the planeswalkers out of the cavern and they scatter the Eldrazi swarm at the cave mouth.
timeline.quote: Gideon was the first to emerge from the cavern

timeline.summary: Gideon realizes none of them have left and argues that together the four can stand against the Eldrazi.
timeline.quote: But maybe four of us can,

timeline.summary: Gideon swears an oath to keep watch against all threats to the Multiverse.
timeline.quote: For Sea Gate, for Zendikar and all its people, for justice and peace, I will keep watch.

timeline.summary: Chandra swears the oath, saying every world has its tyrants, and Nissa embraces her.
timeline.quote: If it means that people can live in freedom, yeah, I'll keep watch.

timeline.summary: The four set out to find Tazri and form a plan.
timeline.quote: I left Tazri and a small group of soldiers a couple miles back that way.

timeline.summary: The four planeswalkers enter a ravine covered in Kozilek's trail and find Tazri, Munda, Jori En, Kiora and Drana's emissary arguing over a strike plan.
timeline.quote: Standing tall, bident in hand, cocky smile still in place, was the merfolk Planeswalker Kiora

timeline.summary: Nissa admits she removed the last failsafe and let the Eldrazi out, and Jace confesses he was part of the reason the failsafe was needed.
timeline.quote: I let them out, said Nissa.

timeline.summary: Jace lays out the plan: lure the titans into an ambush, bind them with Nissa's leylines, and drain them, with Kiora clearing the basin and Chandra told not to attack the titans.
timeline.quote: When the time comes, Nissa weaves the leylines together and binds the titans.

timeline.summary: Jace warns that the titans may get bigger as they are drawn into physical space, and Kiora agrees to follow the plan with a warning.
timeline.quote: Meaning they may get, um, bigger,

timeline.summary: Chandra serves breakfast heated with her hands, and Nissa brings blankets for her to warm.
timeline.quote: the blankets warmed.

timeline.summary: Gideon tells Chandra the Eldrazi sweep seems done, and Chandra insists she is part of the Gatewatch.
timeline.quote: I'm in this, Gideon. I'm part of the Gatewatch now.

timeline.summary: Ugin lands furiously among the Zendikari, demanding to know what Jace has done.
timeline.quote: What have you done?

timeline.summary: Ugin scolds the planeswalkers for killing two ancient beings, says he will study their remains, tells Jace to leave, and warns of Sorin and Bolas.
timeline.quote: have proven to be an extremely arrogant and unreliable partner.

timeline.summary: Chandra talks Nissa into leaving Zendikar with the Gatewatch, saying Nissa can still protect it by standing with them.
timeline.quote: No one else can do it,

timeline.summary: Chandra leads the group that baits Ulamog, while Gideon leads the other bait army toward Kozilek, toward Jace and Nissa waiting in the titans' path.
timeline.quote: The plan involved being as noticeably, tantalizingly alive as possible

timeline.summary: Jace and Kiora clear Eldrazi drones from the path of the bait army, with Kiora riding waves and sweeping them into a ravine.
timeline.quote: a wall of water swung around her like a sea god's punch

timeline.summary: The two bait armies cross in front of Nissa and Jace, and Jace signals them to disperse.
timeline.quote: Disperse the army. The titans are in position!

timeline.summary: The titans distort, the sky becomes the titans, and it begins raining Eldrazi.
timeline.quote: And then it began raining Eldrazi.

timeline.summary: Chandra wants to burn the titans but Jace forbids it, since damage would collapse the glyph.
timeline.quote: Any damage to the titans or to Nissa will snap the leylines and collapse the glyph spell.

timeline.summary: Gideon sides with Chandra, and Jace asks Chandra if she is certain she can destroy the titans with one spell.
timeline.quote: I'm certain

timeline.summary: Chandra's spell fails to be enough as Gideon blocks a falling landmass with his own body.
timeline.quote: Gideon leaping from the outcropping, blocking the landmass with his own body

timeline.summary: Nissa touches Chandra's shoulder, sending the mana of all Zendikar through her, and Chandra ignites the leylines.
timeline.quote: The leylines themselves caught fire

timeline.summary: The titans are destroyed in a blinding blast, and Chandra collapses.
timeline.quote: The world flashed with a roar of apocalyptic orange, then went blinding white.

timeline.summary: Survivors gather in the ash with no celebration, and Kiora leaves with the bident.
timeline.quote: And she didn't stop walking for a long time.

timeline.summary: Jace arrives to Chandra's greeting and the smiling face of his friend.
timeline.quote: the afterimage of Emrakul looming above gave way to the smiling face of his friend.

timeline.summary: Chandra and Nissa arrive, and Jace lays out the plan: Nissa taps the leylines with her glyph, Gideon clears a path, and Chandra channels the energy.
timeline.quote: Nissa will use her planar glyph to tap into the leyline network.

timeline.summary: Chandra unleashes a huge firestorm against the mutated horde, scorching her friends, and the group is trapped in a market square.
timeline.quote: They were trapped in what had been a market square

timeline.summary: Jace has Chandra topple a lattice-scarred tower with two fireballs to block a street.
timeline.quote: Seconds later, the entire structure collapsed, blocking off most of the street

timeline.summary: Nissa begins the planar glyph in the market square while Gideon charges the horde to protect her.
timeline.quote: He roared a challenge as he slashed in a wide circle

timeline.summary: Chandra refuses to leave: they all walk out together or not at all.
timeline.quote: "Not gonna happen. We're all walking out of here together, or..."

timeline.summary: Nissa and Gideon recoil from the Chain Veil, while Chandra defends Liliana as having saved them.
timeline.quote: "That...thing she carries. It's an abomination."

timeline.summary: Emrakul unfolds, growing countless tendrils and releasing a wave of power that hits every planeswalker.
timeline.quote: in that shifting Emrakul unfolded

timeline.summary: The other planeswalkers collapse under Emrakul's mental assault, except Jace, who casts a spell in response.
timeline.quote: The other Planeswalkers crumpled, all except Jace, who cast some type of spell in response.

timeline.summary: Jace sees a vision of child Chandra surrounded by guards who say they killed her parents, and she burns them all.
timeline.quote: I can make the whole world burn.

timeline.summary: Jace links the group's minds; Jace and Nissa tell Chandra that burning Emrakul will not work.
timeline.quote: Trying to burn Emrakul is throwing a torch into the ocean.

timeline.summary: Liliana wakes a hungover Chandra at noon in Jace's house.
timeline.quote: Morning, Liliana

timeline.summary: Liliana guesses Chandra spent the night at the Izzet air races.
timeline.quote: You went to see the Izzet air races.

timeline.summary: Liliana notes Nissa has barely left the roof garden since the first morning.
timeline.quote: She's been staying in the roof garden ever since.

timeline.summary: Liliana explains she keeps her own lodgings because she dislikes relying on others, hiding that she will not sleep under a roof Jace paid for.
timeline.quote: I mislike relying on the mercy of others

timeline.summary: Chandra storms out of the meeting furious at Baan's description of the renegades.
timeline.quote: Chandra's chair tilted over backward as she bolted to her feet.

timeline.summary: Chandra rages that the Consulate killed Kaladesh's best inventors as she punches Gideon's punching bag.
timeline.quote: They killed the best damn inventors on Kaladesh.

timeline.summary: Gideon's punching bag bursts into flames and Chandra puts it out with a bucket, leaving a sand pile.
timeline.quote: The canvas of Gids's punchybag bursts into flames.

timeline.summary: Chandra wonders whether she belongs and thinks of returning to Regatha.
timeline.quote: I should go back to Regatha.

timeline.summary: Chandra remembers floating in green when she touched Nissa's mind and is drawn to seek her out.
timeline.quote: She was floating in green and I could breathe there.

timeline.summary: Chandra finds Nissa sitting on moss in her flower-filled room.
timeline.quote: She's sitting cross-legged on a patch of moss.

timeline.summary: Chandra clumsily tells Nissa that on Zendikar she felt Nissa's calm mind behind the world's anger.
timeline.quote: But behind Zendikar, behind the anger and the power, I felt you

timeline.summary: Nissa offers to teach Chandra to meditate.
timeline.quote: I can teach you to meditate, if you wish.

timeline.summary: Mortified, Chandra flees Nissa's room.
timeline.quote: I turn and run, trailing sparks, trees and flowers smearing around me, banging through the door.

timeline.summary: Chandra rushes past Baan and Gideon, apologizing for blowing up the punching bag.
timeline.quote: SorryIblewupyourthingy

timeline.summary: Liliana finds Chandra hiding in an alley and persuades her to come along shopping.
timeline.quote: She was crouched halfway down an alley three blocks from Jace's home

timeline.summary: Liliana invites Chandra to join her and talk on the way.
timeline.quote: Then I suppose you'll have to come along and see.

timeline.summary: Gideon tells Baan about what Nissa and Chandra did on Zendikar.
timeline.quote: I was telling Minister Baan what you did on Zendikar.

timeline.summary: Lavinia reports that Liliana and Chandra spent the afternoon in the market district and then planeswalked together.
timeline.quote: They spent the afternoon wandering the market district

timeline.summary: Baan explains that Chandra's parents, hunted after she manifested pyromancy, were reported dead when Bunarat was set ablaze.
timeline.quote: the girl escaped custody when she manifested dangerous pyromantic abilities

timeline.summary: Gideon defends Chandra, saying her parents' sins have nothing to do with her.
timeline.quote: But her heart's the size of the moon.

timeline.summary: Nissa says Chandra's past was hers to share, since everyone has scars others should not touch.
timeline.quote: We all have scars we don't want others to touch.

timeline.summary: Nissa volunteers to go to Kaladesh with Baan and stand with Chandra.
timeline.quote: I'll stand with her.

timeline.summary: Chandra planeswalks back to Kaladesh for the first time since she left.
timeline.quote: Before she could take a deep, soothing breath, though, she had arrived.

timeline.summary: Chandra resolves to find the renegade inventor she believes is in danger, though the Gatewatch does not care.
timeline.quote: Somewhere in this crowd was the renegade she sought

timeline.summary: Liliana appears on the balcony next to Chandra, having followed her.
timeline.quote: Standing on the formerly unoccupied balcony next to her was Liliana

timeline.summary: Liliana persuades Chandra to celebrate her return while still looking for the renegade.
timeline.quote: Then I think it's high time we celebrated your grand return to your hometown.

timeline.summary: Liliana and Chandra's search turns into mingling with inventors and dancing.
timeline.quote: Chandra's and Liliana's search for the renegade had become a series of chats with renegade sympathizers

timeline.summary: Liliana throws her drink in a Consulate vedalken's face and introduces Chandra as a renegade sympathizer.
timeline.quote: tossing her drink into the vedalken's face

timeline.summary: When the soldier pulls out restraints, Chandra punches him unconscious.
timeline.quote: Chandra's fist arced around and collided with his jawbone in one fluid motion.

timeline.summary: Chandra and Liliana flee out the back of the nightclub.
timeline.quote: Chandra hopped a guardrail and ducked through the back of the nightclub.

timeline.summary: Chandra shows Liliana a worn mosaic of her father Kiran and says her parents were killed when she was a child.
timeline.quote: They were killed when I was a child.

timeline.summary: Chandra blames a uniformed officer named Baral for her parents' deaths.
timeline.quote: My parents died because of him.

timeline.summary: Liliana urges Chandra to find Baral and burn him, and Chandra swears he will pay.
timeline.quote: I swear he's going to pay for what he did.

timeline.summary: Chased by Consulate guards, Chandra refuses Liliana's lethal option and blocks the alley with a wall of fire.
timeline.quote: spreading into a wall of fire that spanned the alley's width

timeline.summary: Chandra and Liliana jump onto the Aradara dawn train to escape.
timeline.quote: Chandra ran and stepped up, putting her hand in the way as the doors tried to close.

timeline.summary: The train stops amid an aether disruption that Chandra attributes to the renegade.
timeline.quote: A disruption. The aftermath of some kind of aerial display.

timeline.summary: Chandra burns open the train door and they leap off to reach the disruption.
timeline.quote: Chandra hot-punched the door handle.

timeline.summary: Chandra calls to the hooded man, who runs away through the crowd.
timeline.quote: he dashed away from them, through a bank of onlookers and around a Consulate checkpoint.

timeline.summary: The woman with Chandra's auburn hair stuns Chandra, who is shocked.
timeline.quote: She had auburn hair like Chandra's, but darker

timeline.summary: Chandra, gaping at the woman with hair like hers, speaks to her as her mother.
timeline.quote: gaping at the woman with the hair like hers

timeline.summary: In a Dhund cell Baral tells Pia he killed her daughter and tosses a melted piece of Chandra's vent pack, stamped K.N. and the leaking spire, as a memento (flashback).
timeline.quote: I killed your daughter today, Pia.

timeline.summary: Baral blames Chandra for his scars and Pia answers that a mother could not be prouder.
timeline.quote: this is the work of your child.

timeline.summary: Pia sees Chandra, grown and unmistakable, and is flooded with memories.
timeline.quote: Older but unmistakable. Her little girl, now even taller than Kiran had been.

timeline.summary: Chandra charges the soldiers and burns a crowd of automatons.
timeline.quote: inundated a crowd of the machines with a generous bath of flames

timeline.summary: Baan orders the soldiers to isolate and contain the pyromancer with gearhulks.
timeline.quote: Isolate and contain. Gearhulks in the front line

timeline.summary: Pia kicks and bashes soldiers to draw Chandra's attention and stop her advance.
timeline.quote: You forgot assault!

timeline.summary: Liliana tells Chandra they must retreat as the soldiers drag Pia away.
timeline.quote: They have her! You can't risk it now; we have to go!

timeline.summary: Liliana cruelly tells Nissa that Chandra ran from her and came to Liliana.
timeline.quote: She ran from you

timeline.summary: Oviya Pashiri comforts Chandra and says they will free her mother from the Consulate.
timeline.quote: when we find your mother and take her back from those Consulate soldiers, Chandra.

timeline.summary: Mrs. Pashiri brings Chandra and Nissa to Yahenni's party.
timeline.quote: this is Chandra and Nissa

timeline.summary: Yahenni admits he cannot say where the Consulate would hold a prisoner of Pia's standing.
timeline.quote: I don't know where the Consulate would take prisoners of Pia's standing.

timeline.summary: Chandra snaps that Yahenni would help if it were his parent.
timeline.quote: If it was your parent you'd help us,

timeline.summary: Yahenni offers Chandra and Nissa information in return for removing the enforcer and breaking the door.
timeline.quote: I'll give you the information you need if you'll help me.

timeline.summary: Chandra melts the lock of the bathroom door with a white-hot finger.
timeline.quote: quickly melts the locks with a white-hot finger to the metal

timeline.summary: Yahenni tells them Pia is at Dhund and Mrs. Pashiri warns that Baral is stationed there.
timeline.quote: Baral is stationed there.

timeline.summary: Chandra and Mrs. Pashiri leave at once to find Pia.
timeline.quote: We need to go now,

timeline.summary: Mrs. Pashiri leads Chandra and Nissa to Gonti's night market, since the Dhund lies in tunnels beneath it.
timeline.quote: I'm told the Dhund lies in tunnels beneath the night market.

timeline.summary: Chandra rejects Nissa's offer of calm and says she only wants to find her mother.
timeline.quote: I want to find my mom.

timeline.summary: Nissa works out that the way aether flows through the city can guide them to the Dhund.
timeline.quote: It has to do with the way aether flows through the city.

timeline.summary: Chandra melts a steel door's handle with white-hot fire.
timeline.quote: A blast of white-hot fire leapt from Chandra's hand to engulf the door handle

timeline.summary: Chandra kicks down a guard while Nissa's vines dismantle his automaton.
timeline.quote: Vines broke through the concrete floor and coiled around its legs

timeline.summary: Nissa admits she cannot find Pia directly in the tunnels.
timeline.quote: Finding your mother down here is another matter entirely.

timeline.summary: Chandra snaps at Nissa asking if she even has a mother, and Nissa reveals that Ulamog destroyed her people's home of Bala Ged.
timeline.quote: it was the first place he destroyed

timeline.summary: Chandra erupts at Mrs. Pashiri for leading them around in circles.
timeline.quote: You've been leading us around in circles while they have my mom?

timeline.summary: Chandra steps through an illusory wall and discovers it is not real.
timeline.quote: disappearing through the stone as if it were a wall of water

timeline.summary: Beyond the illusion, the tunnels become clean, well-lit corridors lined with bureaucrats' offices.
timeline.quote: The tunnel network was utterly transformed.

timeline.summary: Armored figures surround them and a scarred man, Baral, unmasks.
timeline.quote: One of the figures reached up and pulled off a filigree mask that covered his face.

timeline.summary: Chandra's firestorm is absorbed into Baral's hand device.
timeline.quote: the flames vanished as they reached him

timeline.summary: Baral raises walls that trap the three in a sealed chamber.
timeline.quote: she slammed into a wall that shot up from the floor

timeline.summary: Baral says Baan told him she was back and promises she will not escape again.
timeline.quote: Baan said you were back. I couldn't believe it.

timeline.summary: Baral calls Chandra a pathetic freak of nature and tells her to burn all she likes and die more quickly.
timeline.quote: You'll die more quickly if you burn up the air.

timeline.summary: Nissa touches Chandra's back and briefly feels Chandra's fire in her soul.
timeline.quote: A channel opened between them

timeline.summary: Chandra begs Baral to let the others and her mother go and kill only her, but he refuses.
timeline.quote: Kill me, just me.

timeline.summary: Chandra's wave of fire reflects back on her, and Nissa shields Mrs. Pashiri with her cloak.
timeline.quote: throwing her cloak over Mrs. Pashiri and trying to shield the older woman with her body

timeline.summary: Nissa realizes poison vapor is leaking into the cell to suffocate them faster.
timeline.quote: He means for us to suffocate more quickly after all.

timeline.summary: Nissa offers to fuel Chandra's fire with her mana to try to melt the door's hinges.
timeline.quote: Let me fuel your fire,

timeline.summary: Their focused flame fails against the counterspell and fizzles out.
timeline.quote: the last flames fizzling out in her hand

timeline.summary: Chandra tells Nissa that the Gatewatch is about not being alone and having a family on any plane.
timeline.quote: Having a family, no matter what plane we're on.

timeline.summary: Chandra refuses to leave the dying Mrs. Pashiri, and Nissa says she will stay with them, thinking of Chandra as her friend.
timeline.quote: I'll stay here with Mrs. Pashiri.

timeline.summary: Ajani sees a hand weakly strike the window of a poison box, and realizes it holds his friends.
timeline.quote: A fist struck the glass. Then a hand, weakly.

timeline.summary: Ajani finds Nissa with an unconscious Chandra and Grandmother Pashiri barely breathing.
timeline.quote: Grandmother lay eyes closed and barely breathing.

timeline.summary: Ajani heals Chandra's poisoned blood and lungs.
timeline.quote: Silver tendrils of healing magic raced through her, cleansing the impurities

timeline.summary: As guards assemble, a rope drops through the window and Ajani leads them out.
timeline.quote: We have a ride,

timeline.summary: Ajani tells Nissa he has followed Tezzeret's movements on Kaladesh for weeks.
timeline.quote: We've been following Tezzeret's movements here for weeks.

timeline.summary: Banners across the city advertise a showdown between Head Judge Tezzeret and the renegade criminal Pia Nalaar the next noon.
timeline.quote: INVENTORS! COME WITNESS THE SHOWDOWN OF THE CENTURY.

timeline.summary: Chandra decides to face Tezzeret's challenge despite the risk of another trap.
timeline.quote: He's calling me out,

timeline.summary: Jace, Liliana and Gideon, disguised as Consulate soldiers, drop their illusions and reunite with Chandra, Nissa, Ajani and Mrs. Pashiri.
timeline.quote: It seems this is a matter for the Gatewatch,

timeline.summary: A thopter photographs the group and delivers the images to Consul Kambal aboard the Skysovereign.
timeline.quote: one that showed the target, Nalaar, daughter of Renegade Prime

timeline.summary: Pia, manacled backstage at the same arena where Chandra was almost executed, hopes her daughter stays away.
timeline.quote: This was the place where Chandra had searched the stands for her mother before being torn out of the world.

timeline.summary: A bolt of fire from the audience fells the attacking automaton; Chandra has intervened.
timeline.quote: The bolt of fire had streaked out of the audience

timeline.summary: Chandra leaps into the arena, refusing her mother's order to leave and declaring she will not lose her again.
timeline.quote: And I'm not losing you again!

timeline.summary: Illusions behind Chandra dissolve to reveal the Gatewatch, and Tezzeret takes a small step backward.
timeline.quote: A host of illusions dissolved behind Chandra, and one by one, a team of Planeswalkers emerged.

timeline.summary: The planeswalkers battle Tezzeret's automatons while Ajani and Gideon protect Pia.
timeline.quote: Fire flew, slamming like fists into Tezzeret's machines, felling one after another.

timeline.summary: Jace warns that Tezzeret's blocked mind means he was prepared and they have made a mistake.
timeline.quote: if he knew to block his mind, it means he was prepared for this.

timeline.summary: Chandra compresses a blinding point of fire to kill Tezzeret as Liliana urges her on.
timeline.quote: Chandra's fist closed, compressing fire into a tiny point of blinding, seething heat.

timeline.summary: Nissa tells Chandra it is over, and Chandra runs into her mother's arms.
timeline.quote: Her mother held her arms open. Chandra ran and fell into them.

timeline.summary: Saheeli tells Chandra and Pia that the inventions of the Fair and Rashmi are gone.
timeline.quote: I think they took Rashmi and the others

timeline.summary: Baan orders a veteran squad to pursue the Gatewatch and exploit their weaknesses.
timeline.quote: Exploit those weaknesses in every way you can. Go!

timeline.summary: Chandra hears from Dovin Baan that Kaladesh is threatened and returns home for the first time since her parents' deaths.
timeline.quote: She returns home for the first time since her parents' deaths.

timeline.summary: Nissa follows her friend Chandra to Kaladesh to help.
timeline.quote: Nissa follows to help.

timeline.summary: Chandra and Liliana arrive at the Inventors' Fair and pursue a suspicious cloaked figure.
timeline.quote: they pursue the person through the Fair.

timeline.summary: The cloaked figure is revealed as Tezzeret, who was stalking Pia Nalaar; Chandra and Pia, each thinking the other dead, are shocked, and the Consulate takes Pia prisoner.
timeline.quote: Tezzeret, Dovin, and Consulate enforcers take Pia prisoner, accusing her of leading the renegade threat.

timeline.summary: Liliana leaves to alert the Gatewatch while Chandra, Nissa and Mrs. Pashiri go to the Dhund, where Baral traps them in a cell filling with poison.
timeline.quote: He traps the would-be rescuers in a cell that rapidly fills with poison.

timeline.summary: Ajani Goldmane storms in and rescues them from the cell.
timeline.quote: the door to the cell flies open, and in storms a leonin warrior come to rescue them: Ajani Goldmane.

timeline.summary: At the Grand Exhibition Chandra runs into the arena and the Gatewatch support her against Tezzeret, who slips away; Pia is safe.
timeline.quote: Just when they think they have Tezzeret cornered, he slips away.

timeline.summary: Yahenni blackmails Gonti with the secret of their manufactured heart, asking where Chandra and Pia Nalaar are hiding.
timeline.quote: "If you tell me where they are hiding, I will keep the secret of your manufactured heart to myself.

timeline.summary: Gonti reveals the renegades' safe house in the Statuary Garden and tasks Yahenni with warning them that the Consulate is coming, to force them into acting.
timeline.quote: You'll find the younger Nalaar and her associates in a safe house within the Statuary Garden.

timeline.summary: Jace causes Yahenni a body ache on the ladder until Nissa and Chandra recognize them and let them into the hideout.
timeline.quote: "Yahenni!" Chandra yells while opening the hatch and pulling me through.

timeline.summary: Chandra introduces Yahenni to Jace, Liliana and Gideon; Chandra says they got her mother free.
timeline.quote: Yahenni, this man is Jace, this woman is Liliana, and the man in the corner is Gideon.

timeline.summary: Nissa has Gideon call back Chandra, who walked the wrong way, and directs the group to Yahenni's home and sends word to Ajani, Pia and Mrs. Pashiri.
timeline.quote: Tell Chandra Yahenni's home is that way, and have Jace inform Ajani, Pia, and Mrs. Pashiri of our new location

timeline.summary: On the roof, Gideon tells Chandra the Gatewatch came for her, not to topple the Consulate; Chandra accuses him of silence.
timeline.quote: "We came for you."

timeline.summary: Chandra agrees to focus on stopping Tezzeret, while also helping her mother as Pia Nalaar's daughter.
timeline.quote: And, as much as I hate it, I'll try to focus on stopping Tezzeret....for now.

timeline.summary: Ajani and the rest of the group arrive after hearing the commotion.
timeline.quote: "We all heard the commotion."

timeline.summary: Gideon assigns roles: Pia and Chandra mobilize the renegades while he, Nissa, Jace and Ajani create disruption against the Consulate.
timeline.quote: We're going to run disruption until the renegades are ready to begin the assault.

timeline.summary: Gideon persuades Chandra to lead by example for the renegades instead of joining the diversion.
timeline.quote: "Lead by example. Lead by your strength."

timeline.summary: Pia brings Chandra to an aetherborn club protected by Gonti where sympathetic inventors gather, asking Chandra to give the speech to spark rebellion.
timeline.quote: Chandra, I want you to do it.

timeline.summary: Chandra speaks about losing her father Kiran, but the speech falls apart and she leaves the stage.
timeline.quote: "Hi. I'm, well, I guess you know who I am. Chandra Nalaar. Pia's daughter."

timeline.summary: The crowd erupts into angry complaints about what the Consulate took from them, nearly becoming a riot.
timeline.quote: The spark had caught quickly, and within minutes; the club threatened to become a riot

timeline.summary: An aetherborn emissary calms the crowd and leads Pia, Chandra and others down a secret tunnel to meet Gonti.
timeline.quote: revealing a tunnel and a descending set of stairs.

timeline.summary: Chandra accuses Gonti of betraying them, but Gonti says he pushed them to act and offers the contents of his storeroom for the insurrection.
timeline.quote: I believe I have what you'll need for your little insurrection.

timeline.summary: Gideon watches the Skysovereign sink; Jace and Kari have broken the blockade, and Gideon insists the target is the Planar Bridge.
timeline.quote: "It's fallen," Gideon said. "And the blockade's gone with it.

timeline.summary: Gideon keeps Chandra on the ship while Nissa and Ajani join Pia on the ground team.
timeline.quote: "I'll go along with the ground team," Ajani said.

timeline.summary: Chandra and Saheeli defend the airship against thopter swarms; Saheeli turns attackers to lead.
timeline.quote: Saheeli reached out with a spell, magically transmuting their delicate metals to clumsy lead.

timeline.summary: Chandra and Saheeli talk about Chandra's father and whether Saheeli would leave Kaladesh.
timeline.quote: "I'm sorry about your father," Saheeli said, unbidden.

timeline.summary: Dovin Baan infiltrates the airship and destroys the crucial disruptor module of Hope of Ghirapur.
timeline.quote: And just as Chandra recognized it, Dovin crushed it.

timeline.summary: Dovin warns the ship has lost fuel and planeswalks away while Chandra fires blindly.
timeline.quote: He was planeswalking away.

timeline.summary: Saheeli discovers the hollowed-out thopter; the group debates calling off the attack.
timeline.quote: "We need to call it off," he said.

timeline.summary: Chandra proposes to be the disruptor herself by riding the thopter into the Bridge; Gideon objects but she insists.
timeline.quote: "From close range, I could be the disruptor.

timeline.summary: Gideon relents and decides to go with Chandra.
timeline.quote: "You're not going alone."

timeline.summary: The oversized thopter bursts toward the Spire with Chandra's red hair visible at its tip.
timeline.quote: she caught a glimpse as she ducked behind the wall, of flaming red hair at the tip of the oversized thopter.

timeline.summary: Gideon shields Chandra with his golden glow as she builds a star of flame for the impact.
timeline.quote: "I've got you," he said. "You're safe."

timeline.summary: Liliana searches the rubble and reflects that she needs Chandra and the Gatewatch as powerful tools to free herself from her demons.
timeline.quote: She needed powerful people, and she'd found them.

timeline.summary: Liliana finds Chandra and Gideon alive; Tezzeret is either buried or has fled to his master.
timeline.quote: "He's either buried in this rubble or run home to his master."

timeline.summary: Pia and Chandra walk through the ruined Dhund to the intact core.
timeline.quote: Pia and Chandra Nalaar made their way through the ruined hallways toward the compound's intact core.

timeline.summary: Pia and Chandra visit the cell of the scarred, imprisoned Baral, who demands his execution and goads Chandra to kill him.
timeline.quote: "Baral." Pia said.

timeline.summary: Baral taunts Chandra about her father's death, but she refuses to be a monster and leaves him to be forgotten.
timeline.quote: "Screw you," she said. "I don't owe you a damn thing."

timeline.summary: Pia tells Baral that they leave him; Chandra leaves a jasmine flower at the cell.
timeline.quote: "My daughter and I leave you today," Pia said. "Stay and be forgotten."

timeline.summary: At Yahenni's penthouse the Gatewatch gather before the party; Gideon forces himself to smile.
timeline.quote: Nonetheless, even here where no one but his friends could see him, Gideon smiled.

timeline.summary: The Gatewatch, except an unsure Nissa, vote to strike at Bolas now; Gideon decides to meet Ajani after facing Bolas.
timeline.quote: "Then we'll meet Ajani there...after we face Bolas."

timeline.summary: Pia and Chandra repair the mosaic of Kiran; Chandra offers to stay, but Pia insists she go and return, revealing she made shrines to both Chandra and Kiran.
timeline.quote: We can stop being a family of leaving, and become a family of arriving.

timeline.summary: Chandra tells her mother she is going to Amonkhet and says goodbye.
timeline.quote: "To Amonkhet. Someplace I've never been."

timeline.summary: Nissa, meditating on the Spire platform, hears skywhales and tells Chandra she lacks the words but wants to be her friend.
timeline.quote: "...your friend."

timeline.summary: Nissa guides Chandra through a calming river visualization and Chandra falls asleep; Nissa watches over her.
timeline.quote: Carefully, Nissa lifted Chandra's radiant featherweight

timeline.summary: The Gatewatch's five planeswalkers appear in the middle of an Amonkhet sandstorm.
timeline.quote: Five figures stood where none were moments ago, caught by surprise in the blinding sands.

timeline.summary: Flashback: on a Kaladesh rooftop, after Ajani leaves, the Gatewatch plans to go to Amonkhet, with Liliana navigating, to find and stop Bolas.
timeline.quote: We go to Amonkhet and learn what we can of Nicol Bolas's plans, then neutralize the threat he poses

timeline.summary: Flashback: the five planeswalk from Ghirapur.
timeline.quote: We traveled infinitely far yet not at all, standing still yet moving at blinding speeds.

timeline.summary: Chandra melts sand into a glass dome to shelter the group from the storm.
timeline.quote: I step forward and shape the still-liquid glass into a simple, crude dome.

timeline.summary: Liliana admits she knows little of where Bolas is; Nissa senses the plane's leylines are weak, and Chandra spots Bolas's horns on the horizon.
timeline.quote: the massive shadow of two horns pierces the sky

timeline.summary: Undead burst from the sand and grab Jace; the group fights a horde while Liliana commands undead to obey, assist and flee.
timeline.quote: rotting hands burst forth from the sand, grabbed Jace by the legs, and pulled him under.

timeline.summary: Gideon, buried under undead, is rescued by Nissa and the two fight toward Chandra.
timeline.quote: Suddenly the limbs of the zombie holding my right arm were no longer attached to its torso.

timeline.summary: Jace's illusion lures a wurm away and Liliana emerges from a dying wurm, wreathed in the Chain Veil's purple light, then collapses.
timeline.quote: I watch, horrified, as Liliana steps forward out of the wurm

timeline.summary: A dead wurm reanimates, strikes Chandra and Jace, and Nissa senses the world is under an ancient curse inverting life and death.
timeline.quote: This world suffered an ancient, powerful curse.

timeline.summary: The group reaches a ridge and sees a barrier-shielded city of obelisks and temples on a river.
timeline.quote: all of which formed a sprawling city that spanned as far as we could see.

timeline.summary: The Gatewatch decides to descend toward the city and its barrier.
timeline.quote: "Only one way to find out."

timeline.summary: Chandra, sleepless and troubled, looks over Ghirapur from the Hub and misses her mother.
timeline.quote: Now she's back, somewhere up above me, just a little bit away.

timeline.summary: Gideon comforts Chandra, and they recall how they met and the Purifying Fire; Chandra confesses guilt over the Sanctum of Stars and asks for a hug.
timeline.quote: He's standing with arms wide, smiling.

timeline.summary: Nissa finds Chandra in Gideon's arms, and Chandra awkwardly tries to explain.
timeline.quote: Nissa sets a plate of eggplant and potato curry on one of the benches

timeline.summary: Baral's amplified voice taunts Chandra about her father's death and her mother's imprisonment, goading her into running out; Nissa follows.
timeline.quote: Have you told your friends the story? About how you got daddy killed?

timeline.summary: Baral leads Chandra through old stone streets toward a trap.
timeline.quote: "All that time your mother suffered . Thinking you were dead ."

timeline.summary: Chandra turns the thorn wall into a fire and injures her arm; Nissa's vines and elemental destroy Baral's thopters.
timeline.quote: A trio of vines leapt up from the neighboring streets, raining debris.

timeline.summary: Baral confronts Chandra and Nissa on a rooftop; Nissa fights his automatons with a sword and Baral nearly kills Chandra with his blade.
timeline.quote: The blade falls.

timeline.summary: Baral claims he killed Kiran Nalaar and Chandra's auntie and prepares to kill Chandra; Chandra gathers superheated fire, ready to release it.
timeline.quote: "I killed your daddy, renegade," he says.

timeline.summary: Nissa embraces Chandra and talks her down from detonating, guiding her to put out the fire through a memory of floating in a quarry.
timeline.quote: "Don't leave us," Nissa says, softly. "You're loved."

timeline.summary: Nissa's elemental batters Baral, and the women escape.
timeline.quote: A tree slammed into him from the left.

timeline.summary: Gideon carries the wounded Chandra to the Heart of Kiran hanging over Weldfast, where the renegades have retreated.
timeline.quote: Heart of Kiran had carried the escapees from the Aether Hub to the safety of Weldfast, solidly renegade territory.

timeline.summary: Ajani heals Mrs. Pashiri and tells Chandra it was not her fault.
timeline.quote: This was not your fault, Chandra.

timeline.summary: Pia embraces Chandra, telling her she cannot lose her again.
timeline.quote: "I can't lose you again."

timeline.summary: Gideon, ruminating on whether the gods are Bolas's agents or his opponents, trudges through the desert with the group.
timeline.quote: To see gods wading amidst the horrors of the desert had not been among them.

timeline.summary: Liliana and Chandra clear zombies at the dome and Jace and Nissa open a hole in the Hekma, and the group enters the city.
timeline.quote: a hole a little wider than Jace's outstretched arms opened to admit them.

timeline.summary: Gideon decides they should keep their other-planar origin hidden despite Chandra's wish to open the people's eyes.
timeline.quote: We shouldn't draw attention to ourselves any more than we need to

timeline.summary: On the balcony Gideon tells Chandra his birth name was Kytheon Iora and explains what gods are and how Oketra differs.
timeline.quote: "Kytheon," he said. "Kytheon Iora."

timeline.summary: A woman runs through the street shouting that the trials, gods and hours are lies; soldiers including a minotaur capture her while Gideon restrains Chandra.
timeline.quote: "The return will bring only devastation and ruin!"

timeline.summary: Gideon promises to quietly investigate and says there is no deception in Oketra, while Jace and Liliana doubt gods.
timeline.quote: But there is no deception in Oketra.

timeline.summary: Temmet explains the woman was pursued by viziers of Bontu and her crop was due for a trial; the group wonders if the people are being harvested.
timeline.quote: "She proved herself unworthy of life among us."

timeline.summary: Nissa wakes, finds the plane's soul painful to touch, and asks Chandra to search for the shouting woman.
timeline.quote: "I'm going to go on a walk to find the woman from yesterday.

timeline.summary: A mummy bursts in with breakfast, startling the group.
timeline.quote: a white-bandaged mummy burst through the door carrying a tray of bread and a carafe of what smelled like ale.

timeline.summary: Nissa and Chandra walk through Naktamun, noting that everyone is a trainee under twenty and mummies do all the labor.
timeline.quote: The enchanted dead were the ones who did all the work.

timeline.summary: Nissa, feeling ill, confesses to Chandra that she is learning what friendship means; Chandra says she wants to be a good friend.
timeline.quote: "I am thankful for your companionship.

timeline.summary: Hapatra introduces herself at Rhonas's Monument and explains that preserved bodies are enchanted to serve the living while they train for the Trials.
timeline.quote: We preserve the bodies left behind, and since training for the Trials is our mortal duty, we enchant the vessels to act in service to humanity.

timeline.summary: Hapatra reveals the God-Pharaoh's return and the Hours begin when the sun rests between the horns, any day now.
timeline.quote: "The Hours will begin when the sun rests between the horns. I'd estimate any day now."

timeline.summary: Nissa and Chandra realize they have two days to find answers and follow Nissa's sense of the woman's energy toward an alley.
timeline.quote: felt the tug of the woman's energy through what was left of the leylines.

timeline.summary: In an old alley, Nissa sees carved glyphs showing eight gods and a recently added horns sigil, concluding Bolas corrupted rather than created Amonkhet.
timeline.quote: Nicol Bolas didn't create this world , she realized, he corrupted it.

timeline.summary: Oketra appears, forbids approaching the sarcophagi, and Nissa tells her telepathically that her world is dying; Oketra shows fear and has no memory of before.
timeline.quote: " These sarcophagi are forbidden to approach ," Oketra said out loud.

timeline.summary: Gideon reveals he is competing in the Trials as Oketra's Champion despite Chandra's objections.
timeline.quote: "These gods are good at their core. I want to prove myself to them."

timeline.summary: Nissa tells Chandra that Bolas corrupted Amonkhet only decades ago, and they resolve to learn what he changed and to speak with Kefnet.
timeline.quote: Nicol Bolas must have come and gone only a few decades ago.

timeline.summary: Gideon and Chandra free Samut from the sarcophagus, telling her they came to rescue her.
timeline.quote: He explained that they saw her days ago evading capture and came to rescue her.

timeline.summary: The Gatewatch share information with Samut, learning that Bolas is a dragon from another world and has tampered with the gods.
timeline.quote: The God-Pharaoh is a dragon from another world, Samut.

timeline.summary: Liliana reveals her third demon is on Amonkhet, and the Gatewatch quarrel angrily.
timeline.quote: My third demon is here.

timeline.summary: The Gatewatch fight without magic, and Samut reaches Djeru and fights alongside him.
timeline.quote: She would protect him. They would fight together.

timeline.summary: Razaketh commands Liliana to come to him, and her body wades into the river of blood against her will; Chandra and Nissa are repelled by necromantic energy.
timeline.quote: her body waded forward into the river of blood.

timeline.summary: Chandra engulfs Razaketh in fire at Liliana's signal, and he rams her into the Necropolis wall.
timeline.quote: a jet of fire engulfed the demon.

timeline.summary: Razaketh stops Liliana's breathing and paralyzes her as Chandra takes aim at him.
timeline.quote: She tried to suck in air, but her diaphragm was completely still.

timeline.summary: Gideon, Nissa and Chandra approach coldly, and Nissa warns that the bloodspell began a chain reaction that sets the Hours in motion.
timeline.quote: The Hours' that herald Nicol Bolas's return needed to be set in motion by the demon.

timeline.summary: The Gatewatch resolves to find a vantage to ambush Bolas, and the others return to Naktamun, regarding Liliana coldly.
timeline.quote: Let us seek a better vantage to prepare for Nicol Bolas's arrival,

timeline.summary: Gideon, in rage, demands they fight Bolas at once, and the Gatewatch attack with everything they have.
timeline.quote: They began. Gideon charged, his golden force shield shimmering

timeline.summary: Liliana urges the others to retreat, then asks Bolas where he wants her to go, and flees, betraying Chandra's trust.
timeline.quote: Where . . . where do you want me to go?

timeline.summary: Liliana vanishes into the void as Chandra screams at her betrayal.
timeline.quote: She surrounded herself in a glowing nimbus of dark energy and vanished into the void

timeline.summary: Chandra drives Bolas back with white fire for the first time, but he dismisses her as a child.
timeline.quote: he was forced backward for the first time in the fight

timeline.summary: Nissa raises spurs and a giant earth elemental against Bolas, but he crushes Chandra in his claw and shatters her defenses.
timeline.quote: He swooped in and grabbed her in a huge claw.

timeline.summary: Bolas strangles Nissa with necrotic tendrils, and she tells Chandra to flee; Chandra planeswalks away injured.
timeline.quote: She planeswalked away in a fiery blaze

timeline.summary: Haunted by memories of lost friends, Gideon chooses to leave and live and planeswalks away.
timeline.quote: He willed his body through the Blind Eternities

timeline.summary: Gideon arrives on Dominaria wounded after Amonkhet, with Liliana, Chandra and Nissa.
timeline.quote: Dominaria coalesced around Gideon and the first thing that struck him was the stench of rotting plants and dank earth.

timeline.summary: Chandra asks where Jace is and Nissa says he has given up.
timeline.quote: He's given up.

timeline.summary: Liliana admits her last demon, Belzenlok, is on Dominaria.
timeline.quote: Belzenlok is here.

timeline.summary: Nissa refuses and walks away, declaring her watch over.
timeline.quote: I'm sorry, but my watch is over.

timeline.summary: Chandra announces she will leave to become stronger.
timeline.quote: I'm going too.

timeline.summary: Chandra planeswalks away in a rush of fire.
timeline.quote: Her form disappeared in a rush of fire as she walked from the plane.

timeline.summary: Chandra returns to Regatha and sneaks into Keral Keep.
timeline.quote: Chandra walked across the planes to Regatha.

timeline.summary: Chandra reveals she sensed Jaya Ballard's aether trail on Dominaria.
timeline.quote: Just after Nissa disappeared, Chandra had noticed fresh traces of a powerful pyromancer's aether trail on Dominaria.

timeline.summary: Chandra takes Jaya's goggles from the monastery's relics and is caught by Luti.
timeline.quote: Chandra, what are you doing?

timeline.summary: Chandra explains she needs more power to fight Nicol Bolas.
timeline.quote: I need more power to fight Nicol Bolas.

timeline.summary: Chandra rejects Luti's advice and leaves for Dominaria.
timeline.quote: But Chandra had already turned, ghostly fire flaring up around her as she stepped out of the plane.

timeline.summary: Chandra arrives in Argivia, which is preparing for a kobold attack.
timeline.quote: This place was Argivia, the capital city of New Argive

timeline.summary: A townswoman tells Chandra about the kobolds and Prossh and a pyromancer helping Steward Baird.
timeline.quote: it's the kobolds of the Kher Ridges again, and that horrible god-dragon of theirs, Prossh.

timeline.summary: Chandra finds a dead Argivian scout on the road.
timeline.quote: realized it was a dead body.

timeline.summary: Chandra sees kobolds building an ambush barricade in the name of Prossh.
timeline.quote: They were building a barricade across the road

timeline.summary: Chandra fights off kobolds that discover her.
timeline.quote: Chandra sent a fireball into the first kobold's chest and he tumbled back down the hill, screeching.

timeline.summary: Chandra blasts through the barricade to clear the way for the Argivians.
timeline.quote: She sent the burst of fire streaking toward the logs.

timeline.summary: Chandra loses control and fries half a dozen kobolds with a wild blast.
timeline.quote: The carefully targeted stream of fire turned into a wild blast that fried the half dozen kobolds in its path.

timeline.summary: Baird tells Chandra the pyromancer Jaya Ballard left the force.
timeline.quote: Yes, that is her, but she left our force in the ridges.

timeline.summary: Baird says Jaya came looking for a friend and went toward Yavimaya.
timeline.quote: To the Yavimaya forest, I believe.

timeline.summary: Chandra reaches the coast across from Yavimaya.
timeline.quote: This had to be Yavimaya.

timeline.summary: Chandra sees trees trembling and hears fighting in Yavimaya.
timeline.quote: Suddenly a whole section of huge trees on an inland hillside rippled and trembled

timeline.summary: Chandra finds giant automatons digging a crater.
timeline.quote: They were each around twenty feet high, with scoops for hands and big blocky heads.

timeline.summary: A small automaton warns Chandra that the trees attack any movement.
timeline.quote: Take care. They will attack any movement.

timeline.summary: The automaton says Multani animated the trees.
timeline.quote: They're animated trees, created and sent by Multani.

timeline.summary: Chandra burns a row of attacking trees.
timeline.quote: She reached a spot of higher ground where she had a better angle and sent a stream of fire down the whole row of trees.

timeline.summary: Karn explains Multani is injured and acts out of instinct.
timeline.quote: Multani is an elemental, and has been in a semiconscious state

timeline.summary: Karn reveals he is the friend who has been gone a long time.
timeline.quote: I'm Karn. And I am someone who has been gone for a long time.

timeline.summary: Mother Luti appears in Yavimaya and claims the goggles, revealing herself as Jaya.
timeline.quote: I believe those are mine.

timeline.summary: Chandra confronts Jaya, who has revealed she was posing as Mother Luti, and Jaya explains she went back to Regatha to find a religion built on her and guided it.
timeline.quote: Two hundred years later, I went back and found they'd started a religion based on me.

timeline.summary: Chandra offers Jaya her goggles and asks for the secret to being a more powerful pyromancer, and Jaya flatly refuses.
timeline.quote: Jaya took the goggles, and her expression turned hard as stone. "Absolutely not."

timeline.summary: The next morning Karn tells Chandra that the automatons are digging for the Sylex, which Urza created, and that he means to detonate it on New Phyrexia.
timeline.quote: It was created by Urza to help defeat the Phyrexians. I intend to take it to New Phyrexia and detonate it there.

timeline.summary: Chandra tries again to change Jaya's mind, and Jaya says there is no secret and that Chandra does not know what she wants.
timeline.quote: There's no secret. To master your power, you need to know what you want, know your true self.

timeline.summary: Animate trees swarm the crater to reach the Sylex, and Chandra and Jaya fight them off with fire.
timeline.quote: They were desperate to get to Karn and the Sylex.

timeline.summary: Multani rises as a giant of roots and branches, and Karn says he is still semiconscious.
timeline.quote: He's still semiconscious. He would never hurt us if he were himself.

timeline.summary: Chandra recognizes Gideon and Liliana aboard the Weatherlight as they call the group to come aboard.
timeline.quote: "Gideon!" She waved wildly.

timeline.summary: Chandra uses Nissa's visualization to calm Multani, who regains awareness and recovers.
timeline.quote: The angry gold light from his eyes and mouth faded to a deep blue, and she was sure she saw awareness there.

timeline.summary: Chandra apologizes to Jaya for how she treated her, and Jaya says Chandra has potential and invites her aboard.
timeline.quote: what you did with Multani shows me you have potential.

timeline.summary: Gideon, Liliana, Jaya and Chandra discuss killing Belzenlok without the Chain Veil, and Liliana raises using the Blackblade.
timeline.quote: It's a sword that slew an elder dragon, and Gideon is too delicate to allow us to use it.

timeline.summary: Jace asks Gideon and Chandra to leave with him and says Liliana cannot be trusted, but Gideon refuses and Chandra chooses to stay.
timeline.quote: You don't understand. You can't trust her.

timeline.summary: Liliana and Gideon argue over whether Gideon should have told Chandra about Josu to push her to help kill Belzenlok.
timeline.quote: Because she agrees with us that it has to be done before we face Nicol Bolas again.

timeline.summary: Chandra practices concentration with thirty-seven fireballs while Jaya says what the Multani episode showed her.
timeline.quote: It was the first indication I'd ever seen that you were capable of concentrating on something for any length of time.

timeline.summary: Chandra admits Nissa's departure made her feel abandoned and says she is now ready to burn Belzenlok and the Cabal off the plane.
timeline.quote: I'm ready to burn Belzenlok and the Cabal right off this plane.

timeline.summary: Urborg's ash cloud comes into view on the horizon as the Weatherlight approaches.
timeline.quote: They were coming up on Urborg.

timeline.summary: Raff casts an illusion that gives Chandra a sword scar for her Cabal bounty hunter disguise.
timeline.quote: Her skin puckered and pulled, creating a sword scar that ran from one side of her forehead to her jaw.

timeline.summary: At dawn the party sees the Stronghold in the volcano's caldera, and Gideon, Chandra, Karn and Teferi set out on foot.
timeline.quote: Belzenlok has done some rebuilding,

timeline.summary: Teferi slows time around a grotto of spirits so the party can pass unseen.
timeline.quote: With a gesture Teferi slowed time around the spirits

timeline.summary: Teferi reveals he fought Bolas long ago and lost, and says he took his spark back to join the fight; Karn says he will consider the invitation.
timeline.quote: One of the reasons I took my spark back was to come with you.

timeline.summary: Teferi casts a time-slowing spell around Gideon and Chandra, who walk through the Stronghold's frozen guards.
timeline.quote: Then he realized Teferi and Karn had seemed to freeze in place

timeline.summary: Gideon and Chandra climb the gate and cross traps past still guards.
timeline.quote: Careful to stay close together, they climbed the gate, the broad crosspieces making a good ladder.

timeline.summary: Gideon and Chandra enter the first hall, then Chandra chains Gideon as her prisoner when the time spell ends.
timeline.quote: Chandra fastened the chains around Gideon's wrists.

timeline.summary: The time spell ends and the Stronghold fills with noise as Cabal cultists run to the defenses.
timeline.quote: Slowly, the silence around them filled like water poured into a bowl.

timeline.summary: Gideon and Chandra, delayed and without the expected diversion, are swept by a crowd into the fighting pit arena.
timeline.quote: Gideon tried to use his chains to brace her, but hands pushed him from behind and they stumbled into the arena with the crowd.

timeline.summary: Belzenlok appears in the arena to the cultists' chanting, and Whisper orders captives into the pit.
timeline.quote: Into the pit, for the glory of Belzenlok!

timeline.summary: Gideon tells Chandra to push him into the pit to buy time, and she does.
timeline.quote: Chandra shoved him, and Gideon pretended to stagger, then tumbled backward into the pit.

timeline.summary: Belzenlok leaves the arena to defend the Stronghold, and Chandra searches for a way to free Gideon.
timeline.quote: Then Belzenlok stood. His voice roared, "Defend the Stronghold!"

timeline.summary: Whisper begins to kill the pit prisoners with black mist, and Chandra attacks her and her guards with fire.
timeline.quote: Whisper was going to kill the rest of the prisoners in the pit.

timeline.summary: Chandra burns the chain lock on the stair mechanism and lowers the stairs so Gideon and the other prisoners can climb out.
timeline.quote: Chandra ran back to the stair mechanism, burned through the chain lock, and threw the lever.

timeline.summary: Radha throws a knife into Whisper's eye, killing her after Gideon's shield deflects her spell.
timeline.quote: Then suddenly a blade blossomed in Whisper's right eye.

timeline.summary: Radha agrees to help Gideon and Chandra after hearing the Weatherlight has been restored.
timeline.quote: "Then I'll come with you." Radha turned to the others.

timeline.summary: Chandra blasts open the treasury doors with fire.
timeline.quote: Her fire washed over it, white-hot, and burned away chains, the sigils powering the guard spells, and the door itself.

timeline.summary: Gideon, Chandra and Radha find the Blackblade in the fourth treasury vault and fight through the Stronghold's hall as the undead overwhelm the Cabal.
timeline.quote: They had found the weapon inside the fourth treasury vault, mounted on a stone plinth like a trophy.

timeline.summary: Gideon gives Teferi the Gatewatch oath, while Karn and Jaya agree to fight Bolas without taking the oath.
timeline.quote: Gideon was giving Teferi the Gatewatch oath while Chandra stood by.

timeline.summary: The planeswalkers leave Dominaria, but Liliana cannot planeswalk and Nicol Bolas appears to claim her.
timeline.quote: Nicol Bolas materialized out of the darkness, his huge scaled dragon form looming over her

timeline.summary: On the new plane Jace tells the others that Liliana never intended to come and used them, but Gideon insists she has changed.
timeline.quote: She used you, just like she uses everyone.

timeline.summary: Jace, Lavinia, Gideon, Teferi, Chandra, Jaya, Ajani and Karn arrive and join the fight, and Gideon names the enemy the Eternals.
timeline.quote: Form up! The Eternals are still coming! We need to save as many people as possible!

timeline.summary: The Gatewatch renews its Oaths, and Nissa speaks hers for the first time.
timeline.quote: Never again. Not on any world.

timeline.summary: Gideon and Jace ask Chandra to return to New Prahv and reactivate the Immortal Sun to stop Bolas bolting.
timeline.quote: We want you to return to New Prahv and turn the Immortal Sun back on.

timeline.summary: Dack Fayden overhears and backs the plan, and Chandra sets off with Rai, Nissa and guildmembers.
timeline.quote: They set off for New Prahv.

timeline.summary: Chandra and Jaya burn the remaining Dreadhorde to ashes with dignity at Samut's request.
timeline.quote: meticulously burned every last one—every last fragment—down to ashes

timeline.summary: Planeswalkers debate what to do with the Immortal Sun, and Ajani insists the Gatewatch renew its purpose.
timeline.quote: we need to confirm that the next time a threat rises, the Gatewatch will be there

timeline.summary: Kaya swears the Gatewatch Oath and is accepted.
timeline.quote: Never again. For the living and the dead, I will keep watch .

timeline.summary: Nissa and Chandra wrap Gideon's armor in leaves and the Gatewatch leads a solemn procession.
timeline.quote: wrapped Mister Jura's armor in the leaves

timeline.summary: Arlinn tells Teferi the nights on Innistrad are growing longer and something is coming, and Chandra leaps down the stairs to greet her.
timeline.quote: "The nights on Innistrad are getting longer, but that means no one's getting any rest."

timeline.summary: Kaya joins them with a joke about pencil on ink-only forms, and Arlinn laughs for the first time.
timeline.quote: "So, you're the one who used pencil on the ink-only forms?"

timeline.summary: Kaya, Teferi and Chandra agree to help and travel with Arlinn to Katilda's coven in the Kessig woods.
timeline.quote: They'll come. They'll help.

timeline.summary: Arlinn introduces her friends to Adeline and the assembled cathars, priests and Kessigers.
timeline.quote: "Adeline's fine.

timeline.summary: Arlinn suggests the church in Thraben may have taken the key, and the group decides to go there.
timeline.quote: She nods. "To Thraben, then."

timeline.summary: The party reaches the ruined Thraben cathedral and sees it overrun with the undead.
timeline.quote: The groans of the unhallowed dead answer Chandra before any of the others can.

timeline.summary: Adeline and her cathars charge the horde while Teferi slows the undead and Chandra covers the rear with sheets of fire.
timeline.quote: Two great sheets of flame fly from her hands

timeline.summary: Arlinn tells Dennick his father is dead and asks about the key; he says his great-grandfather gave it to a vampire of the Markovs for safekeeping.
timeline.quote: My great-grandfather gave it over to one of the vampires for safekeeping.

timeline.summary: Outside Markov manor Arlinn repairs a broken Avacynian symbol and begins a prayer, and her friends join in one by one.
timeline.quote: she rights the symbol and starts a prayer.

timeline.summary: The group crosses the broken bridge into Markov manor and makes its way toward the throne room.
timeline.quote: The bridge floats in pieces.

timeline.summary: Sorin refuses to give up the key, saying he has sacrificed enough and his family may descend into eternal night.
timeline.quote: Sorin snaps the book shut. "No."

timeline.summary: Teferi finds the Moonsilver Key in the hands of a headless statue of Avacyn, and Arlinn takes it.
timeline.quote: Arlinn takes the key.

timeline.summary: The heroes arrive to cheers, but a ward falls and howling begins.
timeline.quote: Deidamia feels the too-sharp pain of a ward going down.

timeline.summary: Arlinn sends Kaya off with the Moonsilver Key to deliver it to Katilda, and Chandra and Adeline ride to the front.
timeline.quote: "Kaya, take the key. Make sure it gets to Katilda."

timeline.summary: Adeline commands the cathars in shield walls while Teferi's time magic stutters a dire's hammer.
timeline.quote: Clusters of cathars stand back to back with spears and shields

timeline.summary: Chandra and Adeline pick up the wounded Arlinn and take her to the Celestus.
timeline.quote: Shifting to her human form, Arlinn takes Chandra's hand.

timeline.summary: Adeline kills a vampire and Chandra burns his body; the two share a moment of respite.
timeline.quote: As she drives her sword through the vampire's heart

timeline.summary: The group finishes its fifth counterattack of the week at a village, where Arlinn cares for a boy who ran to them.
timeline.quote: This is the fifth counterattack they've launched this week.

timeline.summary: Arlinn argues that the endless night will starve the vampires too and proposes visiting Sorin Markov.
timeline.quote: "The endless night doesn't just affect humans."

timeline.summary: Sorin finds Arlinn and the others trespassing in his library.
timeline.quote: All in his library, in his family archives

timeline.summary: The Gatewatch and allies reach the gates of the Voldaren Estate, but the guards admit only one person per invitation.
timeline.quote: "One person per invitation," the guards intone together.

timeline.summary: Chandra remembers the Harvesttide Massacre and agrees they cannot fight without the key; Sorin agrees to enter alone.
timeline.quote: "I've been alone for centuries," he says. "This will be no different."

timeline.summary: Outside, the allies joke about whether there is cake at a vampire wedding.
timeline.quote: "Do you think there's cake in there?"

timeline.summary: Outside, Chandra and Adeline see golden light and the invitation wards crumbling.
timeline.quote: The invitation wards are crumbling.

timeline.summary: The assault force charges across the bridge, overwhelming the gate guards and downing swarms of bats with magic and arrows.
timeline.quote: As the bats descend, hungry for blood, the witches and archers are eager to meet them.

timeline.summary: Chandra and Teferi burn down the manor's great door, beginning the assault proper.
timeline.quote: soon the door before them is only ash

timeline.summary: Adeline, Chandra, Kaya and Teferi fight vampires in the ballroom and discuss whether to help Arlinn.
timeline.quote: "Arlinn knows what she's doing," Kaya says.

timeline.summary: A massive wolf blocks a javelin and dozens of wolves pour into the ballroom, led by Tovolar, who nods that he is here to help.
timeline.quote: There must be dozens of wolves pouring in now

timeline.summary: Sorin cuts through the guards and duels his grandfather Edgar, defeating him.
timeline.quote: In the end, it is Edgar who falls from the rumble first

timeline.summary: A column of light runs to the moon and the sun rises over Innistrad for the first time in months.
timeline.quote: Together they watch the first sunrise over Innistrad in months.

timeline.summary: Arlinn says farewell to her friends, and Kaya leaves, promising to return for ghost business.
timeline.quote: "It's been nice working with you, Arlinn."

timeline.summary: Nissa and Chandra arrive at the tower and Elspeth hands them to Kaya for debriefing.
timeline.quote: Nissa Revane and Chandra Nalaar walked into the light.

timeline.summary: Chandra and Jodah, drinking in the hall, toast and reminisce about the dead Jaya.
timeline.quote: Let me have one turn on Saheeli's time machine, and I'd go back

timeline.summary: Elspeth joins them and speaks of Venser; Jodah reveals he is four thousand years old, and Chandra vows to save Ajani and burn the Phyrexians.
timeline.quote: We're going to save him.

timeline.summary: Nissa and Chandra discuss the situation with Kaya and Saheeli: Jace's alliance is gathering and the Mirrans are about to attack.
timeline.quote: Jace has it on good authority that the Mirrans are going to launch their offensive very soon,

timeline.summary: Kaya explains the Phyrexians' World Tree plan and says they need the sylex to destroy it.
timeline.quote: If the Phyrexians have created their own tree, we'll need something powerful to destroy it,

timeline.summary: Chandra says no cost is too high to destroy the Phyrexians, clashing with Nissa and Saheeli.
timeline.quote: My point is that destroying the Phyrexians is the most important thing. No cost is too high.

timeline.summary: Teferi appears and says he is ready, and Chandra later admits she wants all Phyrexians to die.
timeline.quote: I want them all to die. All of them.

timeline.summary: The planeswalkers wait in Liliana's safe house on Dominaria for two weeks of word from the strike team.
timeline.quote: For two weeks they'll wait here in one of Liliana's cabins on Dominaria.

timeline.summary: Chandra coaches Wrenn on controlling her inner fire and recalls Jaya's teachings and Ajani's killing of Jaya.
timeline.quote: Jaya's dead, Ajani killed her

timeline.summary: Tyvar's arrival heralds the return of survivors from New Phyrexia.
timeline.quote: the brash war-horn boom of Tyvar's arrival falls like an axe between them

timeline.summary: Kaya, Kaito and Tyvar report that Phyrexia has corrupted the World Tree and is using it to invade the planes.
timeline.quote: They're using it to invade the other planes.

timeline.summary: Kaya tells Chandra that the Phyrexians got Nissa.
timeline.quote: They got Nissa.

timeline.summary: Chandra proposes returning to New Phyrexia to take down the World Tree, and Kaya, Vivien, Tyvar and Kaito refuse.
timeline.quote: There must be some other way to take the World Tree down.

timeline.summary: Kaya forbids Chandra from going, warning she would be compleated.
timeline.quote: I can't let you go back.

timeline.summary: Chandra erupts in anger when told to abandon people stuck on New Phyrexia and leaves.
timeline.quote: I'm not leaving our friends behind.

timeline.summary: Chandra confronts Liliana, who says she knows funeral bells and leaves in a blink of inky vapor.
timeline.quote: I just know funeral bells when I hear them.

timeline.summary: Chandra walks into the marsh and weeps, afraid to planeswalk alone to New Phyrexia.
timeline.quote: Going to New Phyrexia is the right thing to do.

timeline.summary: Wrenn joins Chandra, saying the World Tree is alive and that she can reach Teferi with Chandra's fire and the World Tree's power.
timeline.quote: The others were wrong—that tree is alive.

timeline.summary: Chandra, Wrenn and Seven leave to head for New Phyrexia while unseen watchers observe them.
timeline.quote: Let's head out.

timeline.summary: Unseen watchers declare they are there to witness the beginning of the end.
timeline.quote: We are here to witness the beginning of the end.

timeline.summary: Saheeli evades telling Pia what happened to Chandra.
timeline.quote: Pia's been around politicians long enough to know when she isn't getting the whole story.

timeline.summary: Chandra and Wrenn arrive on New Phyrexia and find a bright landscape dominated by a vast Invasion Tree.
timeline.quote: Chandra can't comprehend how tall the Invasion Tree is.

timeline.summary: They find Mirran survivors under Koth and Melira, and Chandra pitches that Wrenn will bond with the tree to guide it.
timeline.quote: We'll head for the tree. Once we're there, I'll attach myself to him, and try to guide him,

timeline.summary: Koth says Karn was taken near the tree and agrees to try to take control of the tree and rescue him.
timeline.quote: We may as well try to gain control of the tree and rescue him at the same time.

timeline.summary: Urabrask explains the guarded pathways and why he helps, saying he serves no one.
timeline.quote: Urabrask serves no one.

timeline.summary: They plan to have Koth launch Chandra and Wrenn across a chasm while the Mirrans distract Norn.
timeline.quote: The rest of the Mirrans will provide a tantalizing distraction for the so-called Mother of Machines.

timeline.summary: Chandra realizes the platform belongs to Nissa and agrees to the plan.
timeline.quote: Let's do it,

timeline.summary: Koth launches Chandra and Wrenn through the air, and bladed bats attack.
timeline.quote: Koth drives his fist into the earth.

timeline.summary: Chandra lands hard on the tree and Wrenn prepares to bond while centurions form around them.
timeline.quote: Plates along the tree shift and reform.

timeline.summary: Centurions speak with one woman's voice and spears pin Chandra to the tree while Phyrexian Nissa attacks Wrenn.
timeline.quote: Green magic crackles around her metallic body, her four arms all acting as conduits.

timeline.summary: Chandra recognizes the Phyrexian figure as Nissa.
timeline.quote: Even with two new arms grafted onto her body

timeline.summary: Nissa tears Seven apart and drops Wrenn, saying she no longer feels pain.
timeline.quote: I no longer feel any pain.

timeline.summary: Nissa reveals the Mother of Machines sent her to stop Chandra, whose plan has already failed.
timeline.quote: The Mother of Machines sent me to stop you.

timeline.summary: Nissa offers to save Chandra by joining Phyrexia, and Chandra sees a vast Phyrexian army across the bridge.
timeline.quote: There is an army on the other side of the bridge.

timeline.summary: Chandra realizes Norn knew about the resistance all along and that it was a trap.
timeline.quote: The whole time they'd been here, she knew what was going on.

timeline.summary: Nissa has copper branches seize Wrenn, whom she calls a fine guardian for Realmbreaker.
timeline.quote: You will make a fine guardian for Realmbreaker,

timeline.summary: Wrenn signals Chandra as flames glow within her, unnoticed by Norn.
timeline.quote: Flames flicker within her pale body.

timeline.summary: In Nissa's own voice, she tells Chandra she misses her and begs her to come, and Chandra is tempted.
timeline.quote: Please, come with us. I miss you.
