timeline.summary: Chandra refuses, and Nissa's face turns to rage.
timeline.quote: I miss you so much. But I can't. I'm sorry.

timeline.summary: Chandra drives her fiery fist into the branch, blowing the platform apart and flinging herself and Nissa away while Wrenn clings to the tree.
timeline.quote: Chandra ducks below Nissa's slicing arm and drives her fiery fist into the branch itself.

timeline.summary: Koth, Wrenn and Chandra are brought as prisoners, and Elspeth recognizes Nissa as a Phyrexian centurion delivering them.
timeline.quote: "Behold the traitors," speaks one of the centurions

timeline.summary: Elspeth heals Chandra and Koth while Norn rages, throwing pieces of her throne that shatter against Elspeth's wing.
timeline.quote: Healing light flows from her into the pyromancer.

timeline.summary: Wrenn, who can no longer walk, asks Chandra to carry her toward the Invasion Tree.
timeline.quote: She scoops Wrenn up.

timeline.summary: Nissa pursues the fleeing group, flinging bodies at them and threatening to kill Chandra unless she drops Wrenn.
timeline.quote: "Drop the dryad and there's still hope for you, Chandra.

timeline.summary: Elspeth dodges Norn's blade storm with a sharp turn and unleashes a ray of light, then flies toward the tree to ensure Wrenn and Chandra make it.
timeline.quote: With all her problems concentrated in one place, Elspeth at last unleashes a ray of light.

timeline.summary: Carried by Chandra toward the Invasion Tree, Wrenn fears she cannot do what everyone relies on her to do, as the tree does not answer her.
timeline.quote: That is what truly frightens Wrenn: the possibility that she may not be able to do what everyone is relying upon her to do.

timeline.summary: Koth shields the group from a rain of needles as Chandra, struggling, carries Wrenn.
timeline.quote: Koth levitates the metal beneath their feet to a shield over their heads.

timeline.summary: Nissa's barbed vine goes through Melira's stomach and attacks Chandra and Wrenn.
timeline.quote: the other end of the tendril's gone clean through Melira's stomach.

timeline.summary: Nissa catches Chandra by the ankle and hoists her up; Wrenn falls and the Mirrans pass her hand to hand toward the tree.
timeline.quote: Nissa lifting her by the ankle with a long and brassy root.

timeline.summary: Nissa strangles Chandra with vines while Melira helps Wrenn up to the observation platform.
timeline.quote: Vines wrap about Chandra's throat.

timeline.summary: A golden angel strikes Nissa with light, forcing her to drop Chandra, whom the angel sets on the platform.
timeline.quote: the angel catches Chandra and sets her on the platform.

timeline.summary: Chandra recalls their talk on Dominaria and pulls Wrenn's fire into herself so Wrenn can shape it.
timeline.quote: Fire's going to burn, no matter what you do, but you can shape it if you try.

timeline.summary: On Kaladesh, Pia Nalaar braces for death on a platform when the Phyrexians suddenly crumble and she thanks Chandra.
timeline.quote: All over Ghirapur it is the same: the Phyrexians are falling.

timeline.summary: Teferi visits the healer's ward and finds Karn, Koth, Chandra and Kaya arguing around comatose Nissa and Ajani and the dying Melira.
timeline.quote: The air in the room is taut as a bowstring when Teferi enters.

timeline.summary: In a flashback, Saheeli explains that Phyrexia's oil likely carried Norn's signal and without her the compleated are inert and asleep.
timeline.quote: I think all of it was tied back to Norn.

timeline.summary: Kaya shares news of the other planes, including that Liliana, Vivien and Tyvar are well and that Jace and Vraska are still missing.
timeline.quote: Still no sign of Jace, or Vraska

timeline.summary: Teferi stops time in a bubble so Melira and Karn can cleanse Nissa and Ajani.
timeline.quote: But here they have only the space between two beats of a drum to save their friends.

timeline.summary: Nissa wakes and reunites with Chandra, giving the survivors hope.
timeline.quote: "I'm right here," Chandra says.

timeline.summary: Nissa attacks Chandra and Koth, and Elspeth knocks her out of her armor and sky; Chandra catches her.
timeline.quote: The elf drops like a stone out of her armor, and out of the sky.

timeline.summary: Nissa digs a grave at night in Zhalfir, wondering whether she lost her spark; her friends say Teferi's and Koth's sparks have faded too.
timeline.storyline: March of the Machine: The Aftermath
timeline.quote: is this what happens when a Planeswalker loses her spark?

timeline.summary: Chandra helps Nissa melt her Phyrexian carapace and bury it, and reveals she will leave the next day to find Ajani.
timeline.storyline: March of the Machine: The Aftermath
timeline.quote: "Tomorrow, I'm leaving to find Ajani."

timeline.summary: Nissa asks what kind of love Chandra has for her and, hurt by her answer, tells her to go; Chandra leaves.
timeline.storyline: March of the Machine: The Aftermath
timeline.quote: "Then be clear—exactly what kind of love do you have for me?"

timeline.summary: Chandra arrives and fights the beast with fire, but her fireballs boil a baobab and make it grow colossal, forcing them into a pit.
timeline.storyline: March of the Machine: The Aftermath
timeline.quote: Chandra pushes Nissa out of the way of its snapping jaws

timeline.summary: Trapped, Nissa confronts Chandra about her broken promise, and Chandra apologizes, saying she still wants to know her.
timeline.storyline: March of the Machine: The Aftermath
timeline.quote: "But I still want to know you."

timeline.summary: Chandra tells Nissa that her connections are changing her voice into something more powerful; Nissa calls to Zhalfir in a chorus and the plane forgives her.
timeline.storyline: March of the Machine: The Aftermath
timeline.quote: The plane answers.

timeline.summary: Nissa realizes the creature is a storm elemental from another plane and channels Zhalfir's power into Chandra to heat it into steam and rain.
timeline.storyline: March of the Machine: The Aftermath
timeline.quote: Chandra pours heat and energy into the creature.

timeline.summary: Floating in the flood, Chandra explains her love and promises to give Nissa room; they kiss.
timeline.storyline: March of the Machine: The Aftermath
timeline.quote: Nissa pulls Chandra into a kiss.

timeline.summary: After celebrating, Nissa and Chandra step through the portal together, hoping to find Zendikar.
timeline.storyline: March of the Machine: The Aftermath
timeline.quote: Hand in hand, Chandra and Nissa step through the portal into just one of infinite possibilities.

timeline.summary: Spitfire arrives at the Aether Rangers' garage where screens show Chandra Nalaar.
timeline.quote: Chandra Nalaar's face is smiling across all their screens.

timeline.summary: Chandra is mobbed by reporters over tea and tries to joke with them.
timeline.quote: Chandra picks up her teacup in one hand and waves with the other.

timeline.summary: Chandra reveals that her only reason to race is to put a smile on Nissa's face.
timeline.quote: The only reason she's doing any of this is to put a smile on that face.

timeline.summary: Chandra says she wishes her mother the best as long as it is second place.
timeline.quote: I wish her all the best, as long as 'the best' is second place.

timeline.summary: Chandra wakes to Nissa reading in bed.
timeline.quote: Nissa. Her Nissa.

timeline.summary: Nissa reveals Chandra talked in her sleep about bringing her back to Zendikar and seems crestfallen.
timeline.quote: You were telling someone how much it would mean to you to bring me back to Zendikar.

timeline.summary: Nissa says she does not want Chandra to fix the problem for her.
timeline.quote: I don't want you to fix the problem for me.

timeline.summary: Pia calls them to breakfast and teases Chandra as her turncoat daughter.
timeline.quote: Don't deprive me of one last breakfast with my turncoat daughter.

timeline.summary: Pia laments that Chandra will not wear an Aether Ranger uniform.
timeline.quote: Of course, she won't be wearing an Aether Ranger uniform.

timeline.summary: Chandra hears a caged creature crying and finds it among Winter's vehicles and ghouls.
timeline.quote: The cage itself is so small that the creature is forced to stand on its hind legs at all times.

timeline.summary: Winter warns Chandra off, threatening she will end up last with six pallbearers.
timeline.quote: Chronic-hero syndrome gets you last place and six pallbearers.

timeline.summary: Chandra heats and bends the cage bars to give the creature a perch.
timeline.quote: She pulls two of the bars apart wide enough to make a little perch for the creature.

timeline.summary: The racers surge off the line while Chandra starts in last place.
timeline.quote: With a speed before now unknown to creation, the racers streak out past the starting gates.

timeline.summary: Spitfire glares at Chandra as she passes her.
timeline.quote: That's why Spitfire makes a point of glaring back as she passes Avishkar's favorite daughter.

timeline.summary: A Keelhauler hovership rams Chandra and Cloudspire teammates protect her.
timeline.quote: A huge, howling hovership rams against the side of Chandra's bike.

timeline.summary: Chandra touches Nissa's pin to remember the stakes.
timeline.quote: She touches the pin Nissa gave her.

timeline.summary: A fireball blasts away glitch ghosts that were attacking Spitfire, though its heat scorches her.
timeline.quote: Until a scintillating fireball blasts them away, replacing one threat with another

timeline.summary: Chandra confronts Winter, who answers that those old enough to race are old enough to die.
timeline.quote: If they're old enough to race, they're old enough to die.

timeline.summary: Chandra hurls a fireball that sends the Speed Demons spinning into a dune.
timeline.quote: Chandra hurls the fireball so hard that only a desperate grab for the handle keeps her from becoming a bright orange smear against the pavement.

timeline.summary: The caged creature yelps when the fireball hits the Speed Demons, leaving Chandra uneasy.
timeline.quote: When her fireball hit the Speed Demons, the little guy in the cage yelped.

timeline.summary: Chandra races through giant oaks that crash down onto the course.

timeline.quote: Slinking among the foliage, he sees a slip of orange-red fire

timeline.summary: Loot encourages Chandra that when you see something wrong you fix it.

timeline.summary: Pia comforts Chandra, saying they improvise and find other ways when things do not work out.

timeline.summary: Chandra tells the god about Zendikar, her girlfriend's favorite place.

timeline.quote: Ketramose said if we head this way for an hour or two, we should see it

timeline.quote: He made you show him where the other Omenpaths are, the ones nobody else knows about.

timeline.quote: From the colors, those are Consulate thugs

timeline.quote: Concentrated light illuminates Chandra's forehead, her back, her ribs

timeline.quote: And many blessings on your relationship.

timeline.summary: Chandra hugs Sita and introduces Nissa.
timeline.quote: You really saved me and mom out there!

timeline.quote: Chandra Nalaar stood surrounded on all sides by cloaked figures in masks

timeline.quote: Jace is alive,

timeline.quote: Manipulating archaics!

timeline.summary: Chandra orders the Shattered to keep Ajani's students busy; walls of fire rise and Ajani breaks his bonds.
timeline.quote: The Shattered blazed into action.

timeline.summary: Ajani and Chandra fight, and he pins her in a hold to stop her attacking.
timeline.quote: He slipped one arm under her chin and the other hand behind her head.

timeline.quote: And before he could stop her, Chandra hurled it over both of their heads.

timeline.quote: Then it brought its hand down and tore the ground asunder.

timeline.quote: "I'll support you, Chandra.

timeline.quote: Two Planeswalkers trudged through the tunnels below Titan's Grave. Neither of them said a word.

timeline.summary: Chandra stumbles in a vision and Ajani catches her by the cloak, then pulls back his hand mid-pat.
timeline.quote: Ajani caught her by the hood of her cloak.

timeline.summary: They hear the archaic wail and Jadzi's voice from ahead.
timeline.quote: They heard the archaic before they saw it.

timeline.summary: They find Jadzi healing the wounded archaic in the titan's skull, opposite a snarl-like swirl of energy.
timeline.quote: Jadzi kneeled in its palm, still, working a complex healing spell across its flesh.

timeline.summary: Chandra holds back from striking the wounded archaic.
timeline.quote: It would be so easy. So why did she hesitate?

timeline.summary: Jadzi, already aware of them, calls out the girl sneaking up on them.
timeline.quote: There's a girl who thinks she can sneak up on us,

timeline.quote: "Something is threatening the future of Arcavios itself."

timeline.summary: Chandra insists the culprit is Jace.
timeline.quote: "It's Jace! I'm telling you, it's Jace."

timeline.quote: Snuffing out an archaic is treating the symptom, not the disease.

timeline.summary: Chandra says Jace is no longer her friend and Ajani argues they cannot turn their backs on him; she rebukes him.
timeline.quote: I get to decide who my friends are, Ajani,

timeline.quote: The dizziness lingered.

timeline.summary: Ajani asks Chandra to work together, and she agrees while privately knowing it is a lie.
timeline.quote: It hurt so bad to lie to him.

timeline.quote: A howl left her as her knees threatened to give out from under her.

timeline.quote: Chandra pooled it all into her right hand.

timeline.quote: "I will stand here as long as I am able. Fire can only burn my flesh."

timeline.quote: A fireball soared at him.

timeline.quote: he hurled her across the chamber.

timeline.quote: he was just in time to tank another jet of fire meant for the archaic.

timeline.quote: She drove a lance of fire into the leonin's thigh.

timeline.summary: Ajani repeatedly throws Chandra away, and each time she gets back up.

timeline.quote: The axe clattered to the ground between them.

timeline.quote: Next to her—with her arm slung across his shoulders like a wounded soldier—was Ajani Goldmane.

timeline.quote: to thicken into amber around him, enveloping the professor before he could react.

timeline.summary: Gold light of unity encases the archaic and settles reality; Chandra and Ajani move again.
timeline.quote: They were encasing it.

timeline.quote: "Oh, damn, she's famous," she says, pointing at the image. "Chandra Nalaar.

timeline.summary: Chandra and Ajani arrive at the flat and tell them that Jace is alive.
timeline.quote: "Jace is alive," Chandra says, and in three words, Vraska's entire world falls apart.

timeline.quote: "There was knowledge he did not possess, specifically about the fusion of planes."

timeline.quote: If we want a chance at making our way to Jace, then we'll need Garruk's help.

timeline.quote: This tower of muscles can only be Garruk Wildspeaker.

timeline.quote: "They don't smell real."

timeline.quote: "I need people who understand wards, seals, magical containment.

timeline.quote: "I don't need to be saved. I came willingly."

timeline.quote: Vraska doesn't hesitate. She swings her legs over the desk and socks Liliana at the angle of her jaw.

timeline.quote: When did I get in a fight ?

timeline.summary: Ajani speaks Greek, Garruk's muscles twitch and Chandra is lost, showing Jace's effects; Opal says they fought Jace three times.
timeline.quote: "Oh, sweetie. You fought Jace three times."

timeline.summary: Vraska and her allies burst into the sanctum and Garruk, Chandra and Ajani collapse asleep at the Theorist's snap while Vraska stays standing.
timeline.quote: The four of them burst into his sanctum, and half a second later, three hit the floor.

timeline.summary: Vraska tells him he is a killer who will murder billions, and he wipes her memory and sends the four out.
timeline.quote: her memory of the last few minutes is resting in the Theorist's hand.

timeline.summary: He orders the others to stop each other, and they fight until he calls it off.
timeline.quote: "Stop the others from stopping me."

timeline.summary: The Theorist disables Chandra's decision-making, ruins Garruk's muscles and steals Ajani's language.
timeline.quote: The Theorist reaches inside Ajani's mind and snatches away an entire language.

timeline.summary: Tam heals the injured allies, restoring Garruk's muscles and Ajani's speech.
timeline.quote: Her eyes light up with blue, and after a long minute, both Chandra and Garruk relax.

timeline.summary: Chandra tells Vraska she wants her friend Jace back so she can kick his ass, and breaks into tears.
timeline.quote: I want my friend back so I can kick his ass!

timeline.quote: It is Jace as the Theorist, twice as tall as the real one

timeline.quote: Vraska feels herself being hoisted up then thrown through the portal into a vast and empty space.

timeline.summary: The allies fall into the tower's memory traps and find a marble plain with a well.
timeline.quote: It's an infinite plane of marble, endless and bare, with what looks like a well at the center of it.

timeline.summary: Chandra asks if Jace would have done this had she been nicer, and Vraska tells her she isn't that special.
timeline.quote: "You're not that special, Chandra."

timeline.quote: Jace steps through, but not the one from upstairs.

timeline.quote: You'll need to find the rest of me.

timeline.summary: Garruk volunteers to carry part of Jace in his head, while Chandra refuses.
timeline.quote: "I will," Garruk grunts.

timeline.summary: Chandra rages against the plan and compares it to Gideon's death, but the Detective calls his death atonement; Chandra hugs him and they trade farewells.
timeline.quote: "It's not like what Gideon did. It's atonement."

timeline.summary: Vraska and her allies enter a hall of phyresis, with the Detective commenting from inside her mind.
timeline.quote: The sight of phyresis makes Vraska's scars ache.

timeline.summary: The group sees an illusion of Elesh Norn, compleated Nissa and compleated Jace; Chandra and Ajani charge, but Garruk warns it is illusion.
timeline.quote: Ahead, in a massive room at the base of a massive tree, is Elesh Norn, gargantuan and gleaming, straddling the great roots of Realmbreaker.

timeline.summary: The World Tree booms and knocks everyone down; Garruk holds back Ajani as they escape through a portal.
timeline.quote: The Phyrexian World Tree pulses with light, and an immense boom from somewhere inside of it knocks them all to the floor.

timeline.summary: Walking into the Singing City, the group's minds fill with telepathic noise from the voices of others and each other.
timeline.quote: This memory trap is the sensation of not being able to shut out the voices of other minds!

timeline.summary: They find another Jace huddled under an arch, covering his ears against the psychic noise: the Warden.
timeline.quote: It's the Jace who keeps the lid on the jar.

timeline.quote: "Lock it down."

timeline.summary: Garruk, Ajani and Chandra reach the portal, but Vraska, compelled by the sphinx, steps off the edge of the building.
timeline.quote: And as easily as one would step off the last stair, she steps over the edge.

timeline.summary: The aberrations vanish from his mind and the heroes rush him, but he freezes them in place.
timeline.quote: The heroes rush the Theorist. Without a second thought, he flicks his hand, and his friends come to a halt, standing perfectly still.

timeline.summary: The Theorist summons portals and his friends' doubles tackle them into the portals, then he weaves the two Multiverses together.
timeline.quote: Each tackles their twin into a different portal.

timeline.summary: Vraska arrives in the Implicit Maze and Chandra tackle-hugs her; Chandra explains that their doubles sent the group there.
timeline.quote: He had our doubles tackle us through portals, which sent us here.

timeline.summary: Vraska's double commands a stone Niv-Mizzet statue and guards the mage-ring with the other doubles.
timeline.quote: The other Vraska sits atop the head of a stone Niv-Mizzet.

timeline.summary: Vraska plans to be launched by Chandra's explosion to petrify her double, guided by the aberrations in her mind.

timeline.summary: Chandra launches Vraska into the air and she lands on the dragon's head.
